niche: underground biohacker and cybernetic implant enthusiast collective offering DIY guides, implant registry, and community forums

typography.heading_font: monospace (e.g. JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono)
typography.body_font: monospace (e.g. Space Mono) with sans-serif fallback for long-form Spanish content

design_system.layout_style: asymmetric grid with off-center hero panels, hot-pink terminal frames, glitch-text headings on light cream background, scan lines, and corner registration marks. Navigation labels and section headers in English; body text, descriptions, member quotes, and forum content in Spanish
design_system.mood: dystopian-optimistic, underground, technical, defiant, terminal-like but on a light substrate (subverting typical cyberpunk darkness)

page_descriptions.home: Asymmetric hero — left 60% column with massive glitched headline 'AUGMENT // RESIST' in hot pink with cyan offset chromatic aberration, Spanish subtitle 'Comunidad abierta de biohackers y exploradores cibernéticos desde 2019'. Right 40% column shows a live-feed style terminal panel listing recent member implant logs in Spanish (e.g. 'NFC subdermal v4 instalado — Lima, 03:42'). Below: 3 off-kilter cards (un-aligned vertically) titled 'REGISTRY', 'GUIDES', 'COLLECTIVE' with Spanish descriptions. Marquee scrolling Spanish manifesto excerpt. Footer with cookie consent bar in Spanish.
page_descriptions.implant-registry: Filterable data table of self-reported implants (anonymized IDs). Columns in English: ID, TYPE, LOCATION, INSTALLED, STATUS. Row content in Spanish where applicable ('Magneto en yema del dedo', 'NFC en mano izquierda'). Left sidebar filters (region, implant category, status: ACTIVE / EXPLANTED / DORMANT) using toggle switches with neon cyan accents. Top stat strip showing total registered implants, active members, countries. Status badges color-coded.
page_descriptions.guides: Asymmetric masonry of guide cards — uneven column widths (some 1-col, some 2-col). Each card has a numbered code (e.g. 'GUIDE_007'), English category tag, Spanish title and excerpt ('Cómo esterilizar tu kit de instalación en casa'), difficulty meter (1-5 dots), estimated time, and warning badges. Filter chips at top: BEGINNER / INTERMEDIATE / ADVANCED / MEDICAL-GRADE. Disclaimer banner in Spanish pinned at top.
page_descriptions.submit-procedure: Form-heavy page — multi-section form with progress indicator (4 steps). Section 1 'IDENTITY': handle input, region dropdown, anonymous toggle. Section 2 'PROCEDURE': implant type radio group with icons, body location selector (clickable anatomical diagram placeholder), date picker. Section 3 'METRICS': sliders for pain level (0-10), healing time (days), satisfaction (1-5 stars), toggle for 'complications experienced'. Section 4 'NARRATIVE': long textarea in Spanish, optional photo upload, consent checkboxes. All labels in English, helper text and placeholders in Spanish. Submit button with glitch hover effect.
page_descriptions.members: Grid of member cards (3-col asymmetric, some cards span 2 cells). Each card: pixelated/glitched avatar, handle in monospace, location in Spanish, count of implants, join date, signature implant badge. Hover reveals a Spanish bio quote. Top of page: search bar and sort dropdown (recent / most augmented / by region).
page_descriptions.events: Timeline of upcoming meetups and workshops. Each event entry off-center alternating left/right with neon connector lines. Fields in English headers (DATE / LOCATION / TYPE / CAPACITY), Spanish descriptions ('Taller práctico de instalación de imanes — Ciudad de México'). RSVP toggle button per event, capacity bar. Past events archive accordion below.
page_descriptions.manifesto: Long-form text page styled as a terminal document. Header 'MANIFIESTO // v3.2' with timestamp. Full Spanish manifesto text in monospace, numbered paragraphs, with key phrases highlighted in neon pink. Margin annotations on right side in English (commentary tags). Signature block at bottom listing founding members. Download as .txt button.
page_descriptions.contact: Split asymmetric layout — left 45%: contact form with toggle for inquiry type (PRESS / JOIN / SECURITY / OTHER), input groups with floating monospace labels in English, Spanish placeholders. PGP key download link. Right 55%: encrypted messaging info panel in Spanish, Signal/Matrix handles, jurisdictional disclaimer, glitchy ASCII art logo.

scrolling marquee with Spanish manifesto excerpts
terminal-style live feed panel with monospace timestamps
neon toggle switches and sliders in forms
scan-line overlay on hero and image elements
corner registration marks framing major sections
responsive_notes: Desktop: full asymmetric grid with off-center elements preserved, 3-col cards with intentional offsets. Tablet (768-1024px): grid collapses to 2-col, asymmetry reduced but maintained via varied card heights, sidebar filters on registry become a top horizontal filter bar. Mobile (<768px): single column stack, hero text scales down but glitch effect retained, terminal feed becomes collapsible drawer, form multi-step becomes vertical stepper with one section per screen, table on implant-registry becomes stacked card list, top-bar nav collapses to a slide-down panel triggered by a monospace 'MENU//' link (not hamburger icon). Scan lines and neon accents preserved across all viewports; marquee speed reduces on mobile.
